finding: In October 2026, about 880 of the 19,230 bus trips CTA schedules on a weekday never showed up on Bus Tracker (4.6%). South of Roosevelt Road, a bus due at a stop was missing 5.4% of the time; north of it, 3.4%.

ledger.source: CTA Bus Tracker vehicle positions, Ghost Buses archive (Chi Hack Night; Mansueto Institute)
ledger.units: Trips per average weekday, by route
method: Scheduled: GTFS trips per route and day
Seen: distinct Bus Tracker trips per route and day
Route-days under 50% seen left out as blank
caveats: A bus whose tracker is off counts as missing
Trips counted, not matched by id
